raw_comment:
1. I noticed that droughts are less present in densely populated areas such as New York and California because these places are situated closer to bodies of water. I also noticed that interior states were more likely to experience exceptional droughts.
2. I wonder if these densely populated areas have more advanced water systems in order to sustain large populations, and if so, can we apply these systems to areas experiencing severe drought?
3. This affects my community because if areas with farmland experience extreme droughts, then the crops may also suffer, and food supply may decrease. 
4. "Drought Severity Across U.S. States"
